_meta.warning: Composition, yield, and alloy-recovery figures are illustrative DEMO values only, not measured or standard-referenced. Do not use for procurement, blending, or specification decisions.
_meta.schema_note: Each category carries: Cr, Ni, Mo, Fe, C, Si, Mn, N (wt%, typical composition contributed by that scrap category), yield (%, metal recovered from charged scrap), alloy_recovery (%, retained alloy content through melting).
_meta.unit: wt% for composition; % for yield and alloy_recovery

categories.description: Clean, segregated prime/home stainless scrap of known composition (e.g. crops, runners, sorted fabrication offcuts).
Obsolete scrap sorted by alloy family (e.g. via XRF sorting), moderate contamination.
Unsorted or loosely sorted obsolete/mixed-grade scrap with variable, less predictable composition.
